{{Top|leg}}
'''Memory Alteration''' was an [[Ee mental power]], and part of the mental skills category. This skill allowed [[Ee]] to rearrange the mental pattern of a target to change their memories. Ee used the skill on visitors to [[Trilos]] so that their tales of the planet would be outlandish so as to deter official scrutiny from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
